contract.name: PluginDexPlugin
contract.desc:
PluginDexPlugin: the ARC-58 plugin a wallet uses to trade and provide liquidity on the PluginDex Vault.

Every Vault call is an inner transaction sent as the wallet's spending account S, so pools, LP tokens,
curve positions and swap output belong to S, and hooks see `ctx.caller == S` with the wallet hint
`wallet.id`. The last inner transaction of each method carries the rekey back to the wallet.

Never updated: the ARC-58 wallet only accepts plugins whose Application.version is 0.

methods.name: opUp
methods.desc: No-op carrier for opcode budget and resource references

methods.name: swap
methods.desc: Swap `amountIn` of `assetIn` through one pool; the output goes to S. Returns the amount out.

methods.name: swapRoute
methods.desc: Swap through 1..4 pools (each hop runs its pool's hooks); `assetOut` is the route's final asset

methods.name: createPool
methods.desc:
Create a pool owned by nobody (pools are permissionless). `payment` µALGO goes to the Vault, which
refunds what it does not use to S. Assets must already be in Vault order (assetA < assetB).

methods.name: addLiquidity
methods.desc: Deposit both sides of a fungible-LP pool; LP is minted to S (opted in here when needed)

methods.name: removeLiquidity
methods.desc: Burn `lpAmount` LP for both sides; curve pools are synced first so S keeps its share of unbooked surplus

methods.name: addLiquidityCurve
methods.desc:
Add to a curve position owned by S (`positionId` 0 opens one). `mbr` µALGO is forwarded for boxes
the curve may create; the curve refunds the excess.

methods.name: removeLiquidityCurve
methods.desc:
Remove from a curve position after a sync. With `closePosition` the emptied position is also deleted
on the curve engine, refunding its MBR to S (only valid when the remove empties every share).
